characters.bio: Town factotum. Knows where every cable runs and which official to bribe with a sandwich.
Third-generation industrialist. Loves a working chimney.
The aristocrat himself. Ostensibly retired, demonstrably not.

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: Mr Soyink? That radio mast was not on the plans yesterday.

beats.speaker: aristocrat_residential
beats.text: Plans? My dear fellow, it arrived under its own steam.
A valve warms with a soft orange glow. Somewhere in the set, a dance band fades into weather reports.

beats.speaker: aristocrat_residential
beats.text: The town has plenty to say. What it lacks is a frequency on which to say it.

options.label: We'll give the town a proper station.
Keep it small, local, and difficult to trace.

beats.speaker: aristocrat_residential
beats.text: Splendid. A proper station, with improper music. Now you are talking my language.

beats.speaker: aristocrat_residential
beats.text: Discreet, neighbourly, and just beyond the regulator's reach. I knew I had come to the right town.
